title: Roller Coaster Park's Ticket Boom!
story: The Roller Coaster Park has seen more visitors than ever! It's having a busy time with lots of people enjoying the rides and fun. More people are visiting because of a new exciting roller coaster.
storyBig: Roller Coaster Park has reported an impressive increase in visitor numbers, growing by 0.7% last month. This surge can be attributed to the opening of a new, thrilling roller coaster, driving significant foot traffic.

title: Toy Craze: Squishies and Bricks!
story: Kids everywhere are rushing to get squishies and building bricks! These toys are super popular. Parents think it might be because they are fun and keep kids off screens.
storyBig: The toy industry is experiencing a surge in sales, particularly for squishies and building sets, as parents and children seek alternatives to screen time. This trend may influence future toy production and marketing strategies.
think: Why do you think squishies and building sets are so popular?
bull: These toys are fun and help creativity!
